summary: Independent SG-5 executable-verification review approved TASK-0033: selected Gates execute through GateRunner-backed GateRun records, passed Evidence has GateRun lineage, failed or unavailable gates fail closed, and the published verification commands were rerun successfully.

criteria.criterion: Every selected required Gate produces exactly one terminal GateRun per attempt or a structured execution failure.
criteria.notes: VerificationExecutor maps selectedGateRefs to GateExecutionRequest attempts; rerun dynamic fixture reported secondGateCount=6 and secondGateRunCount=6, with missing runner covered as structured failure.

criteria.criterion: Every newly current Evidence record references the GateRun that produced it.
criteria.notes: Rerun dynamic fixture reported lineageValid=true and unrunGatePassCount=0; final Evidence entries all include gateRunId.

criteria.criterion: A failed, blocked, timed-out, malformed or missing GateRunner result prevents the owning NodeRun from succeeding.
criteria.notes: Targeted tests cover missing runner, runner exception, timeout, malformed result, unexpected workspace mutation, duplicate idempotency key, bad lineage, and failed required Gate blocking Node success.

criteria.criterion: A goal_verification node cannot pass when any required Claim lacks current passed Evidence produced by an executed Gate or validated reuse.
criteria.notes: Goal verification requires CompletionGateResult.complete and a passed GateRunner execution report; stale and open-defect completion were rejected in the rerun fixture.

criteria.criterion: The dynamic fixture no longer constructs final passed Evidence directly in host code.
criteria.notes: The fixture now uses DynamicFixtureGateRunner and VerificationExecutor; producer report and rerun output show final passed Evidence is GateRun-backed rather than host-authored.

criteria.criterion: Tests distinguish selectedGateRefs, executedGateRunRefs and reusedEvidenceRefs.
criteria.notes: Rerun fixture exposes selectedGateRefs, executedGateRunRefs, and reusedEvidenceRefs separately; targeted dynamic fixture tests assert those surfaces.

criteria.criterion: L0, L1 and L2 Gate paths have at least one passing and one failing test.
criteria.notes: GateRun counts cover L0=3, L1=6, L2=1 with one failed and nine passed attempts; targeted tests include failing and passing GateRunner/Scheduler paths.

criteria.criterion: Full local checks, schema lint and git diff checks pass.
criteria.notes: Independent reruns passed scripts/check.py, lint_awkp.py, targeted SG-5 unit tests, dynamic fixture CLI, and git diff --check.
